name: Commerce Project Browser
description: Adds Project Browser sources that discover Drupal recipes published on Packagist by keyword/category (type=drupal-recipe), including recipes not yet present in the codebase. Each category is a plugin (any module can add one via a #[ProjectBrowserCategory] class) that derives a browsable source, a runtime enabled_sources config override, and a local action on the admin page where it is relevant (payment gateways, shipping methods, Commerce config) instead of a tab on Extend. Ships commerce/commerce_payment/commerce_shipping categories that self-hide when their module is absent. Reads optional per-recipe title/logo from composer.json extra and a Centarro-owned certified-recipes manifest (fails closed). Discovery only: installing a browsed recipe rides Project Browser + Package Manager's own admin-gated flow; no install code lives here. One admin-gated route streams a local recipe's logo.png.
project_description: Adds a Project Browser source that discovers Commerce integrations on Packagist by category, including ones not yet available in the codebase.
